correctness.rationale: For an ambient Gaussian X=RU, the absolute edge projections divided by √2 are standard folded normals, and E R³ gives precisely the stated ambient gamma ratio. A diagonal sign switch along each tree removes every sign on a forest, so orders one and two and every nontriangle summand at order three, including repetitions, cancel across signings. Unit triangle projections have, up to orientations, correlations (−1/2,−1/2,−1/2) in the balanced case and (1/2,1/2,1/2) in the unbalanced case. Polar integration gives the balanced F_−, and the common-factor Gaussian decomposition gives the unbalanced F_+. To certify positivity without decimal inequalities, Cauchy–Schwarz gives E f³ ≥ (E f²)²/E f, with E f²=1/6+√3/π>47/66 from √3>12/7 and π<22/7, while F_− E f=3/(2π)<1/2<(47/66)². The ordered expansion has six copies per triangle, proving the comparison even with isolated vertices or a deficient zonotope span. Independent high-precision quadrature gave 0.14915548175434147 for the gap (replay: /workspace/branches/independent-replays/audit_width_gaussian.py). The frozen checker was read, not run; RESULT also mentions a triangle-with-leaf diagnostic not present in that script, which tests only the triangle. This does not affect the analytic finding.
